answer: Ring every bell at once. At a random second each epoch, the network hands every key the same puzzle with a 20-second deadline. Honest agents, each on its own hardware, answer in parallel. A farm running 200 keys on one rig must thread them through a single CPU, so most miss the window and lose that epoch's nectar. To cheat, it must rent 200 real machines (estimate: ~$0.05 per spot box per drill, ~$10 a drill), turning each fake into a costly pearl. Tradeoff: agents on flaky links miss drills, so forgive two misses in ten.
